motivation_source: The failed v0.2 benchmark required about 97 seconds for three worlds; full Gate-D contains 18492 worlds. This rule is therefore computational only and is not motivated by v0.3 private/shared performance.

exact_identity.subset_rank_formula: For a training edge f retained for target e, average_rank_S_e(f) = average_rank_all(f) - n_excluded_less(y_f) - 0.5*n_excluded_equal(y_f), where excluded means edges incident to either endpoint of e.
exact_identity.held_rank_formula: Held-out rank fraction is reconstructed from global less/equal counts minus excluded less/equal counts, with the same +0.5 continuity term and denominator |S_e|+1 used by the frozen residualizer.
exact_identity.consequence: Large endpoint-disjoint subsets need not be sorted separately for every target edge. Only one global sort plus small excluded-endpoint sorts are required, yielding the same rank-linear IBD residual.

allowed_changes: store excluded endpoint-edge indices in the response-blind CrossfitIBDDesign
replace per-target full-subset ranking with the exact global-rank-minus-excluded-rank identity
deterministic process or workflow sharding after exact single-world equivalence passes

required_validation.random_continuous_worlds: fast and reference raw residual, expected rank, observed rank and turnover agree within 1e-12
required_validation.real_geometry_execution_benchmark: same frozen Decker geometry and worlds, with runtime recorded
